康熙五十一年至五十四年

units.zh: 列傳七十
units.en: Biographies 70
units.literal: Biographies 70

units.zh: 覺羅武默訥舒蘭拉錫拉錫子旺札爾孫博靈阿圖理琛何國宗
units.en: Jue Luo Wu Mone, Shu Lan, La Xi, Wangzhar son of La Xi, Boling'a the grandson, Tulichen, and He Guozong
units.literal: Jue Luo Wu Mone, Shu Lan, La Xi, Wangzhar son of La Xi, Boling'a the grandson, Tulichen, and He Guozong

units.zh: 覺羅武默訥，正黃旗人，景祖第三兄索長阿四世孫也。
units.en: Jue Luo Wu Mone belonged to the Plain Yellow Banner and was a fourth-generation descendant of Suochanga, the Jing Emperor's third elder brother.
units.literal: Jue Luo Wu Mone was of the Plain Yellow Banner, a fourth-generation descendant of Suochanga, the third elder brother of the Jing Emperor.

units.zh: 順治四年，授世職拖沙喇哈番，累進三等阿達哈哈番，擢一等侍衛。
units.en: In Shunzhi 4 he received the hereditary rank of Tusahara Khan, rose in steps to third-rank Adaha Khan, and was promoted to first-class imperial bodyguard.
units.literal: In the fourth year of Shunzhi he was granted the hereditary rank of Tusahara Khan, was promoted in succession to third-rank Adaha Khan, and was elevated to first-class imperial bodyguard.

units.zh: 康熙六年，授內大臣，管佐領。
units.en: In Kangxi 6 he was made an inner minister and put in charge of a banner company.
units.literal: In the sixth year of Kangxi he was appointed inner minister and placed in charge of a company.

units.zh: 十六年，命偕侍衛費耀色、塞護禮、索鼐瞻禮長白山，諭曰：「長白山祖宗發祥之地，爾等赴吉林，選識路之人，瞻視行禮，並巡視寧古塔諸處，於大暑前馳驛速往。」
units.en: In Kangxi 16 he was sent with the bodyguards Fei Yaose, Sai Huli, and Suonai to worship at Mount Changbai. The emperor instructed them: "Mount Changbai is where our ancestors first rose. Go to Jilin, find guides who know the way, perform the observance and rites, and inspect Ningguta and the surrounding region. Ride post-horses and hurry there before the height of summer."
units.literal: In the sixteenth year he was ordered, together with the bodyguards Fei Yaose, Sai Huli, and Suonai, to pay homage at Mount Changbai. The instruction ran: "Mount Changbai is the place where our forefathers rose to prominence. You are to go to Jilin, choose men who know the route, perform the rites of observation and worship, and also inspect the region of Ningguta and elsewhere; ride post-horses and go with all speed before the Great Heat."

units.zh: 五月己卯，武默訥等發京師；
units.en: On jimao day in the fifth month Wu Mone and his party left the capital;
units.literal: On the day jimao of the fifth month Wu Mone and the others set out from the capital;

units.zh: 己丑，至盛京，東行；
units.en: on jichou day they reached Shengjing and traveled east;
units.literal: on the day jichou they reached Shengjing and proceeded east;

units.zh: 戊戌，至吉林。
units.en: on wuxu day they arrived at Jilin.
units.literal: on the day wuxu they reached Jilin.

units.zh: 詢土人，無知長白山路者。
units.en: They asked the locals, but no one knew the route to Mount Changbai.
units.literal: They questioned the local people, but none knew the mountain road to Changbai.

units.zh: 得舊居額赫訥殷獵戶岱穆布魯，言其父曾獵長白山麓，負鹿歸，道經三宿，似去額赫訥殷不遠。
units.en: They found Daimuburu, a hunter who had long lived at Eheneo, who said his father had hunted at the foot of Changbai, carried a deer home, and spent three nights on the road—suggesting the mountain was not far from Eheneo.
units.literal: They found an old resident, the hunter Daimuburu of Eheneo, who said his father had once hunted at the foot of Changbai, carried back a deer, and on the return journey had spent three nights on the road—it seemed not far from Eheneo.

units.zh: 自吉林至額赫訥殷，陸行十日，舟行幾倍之。
units.en: Overland from Jilin to Eheneo took ten days; by river it took nearly several times longer.
units.literal: From Jilin to Eheneo was ten days overland; by boat it took nearly several times as long.

units.zh: 寧古塔將軍巴海令運米十七艘詣額赫訥殷，先發，並令協領薩布素護武默訥等行。
units.en: General Baha of Ningguta sent seventeen grain boats ahead to Eheneo and ordered Assistant Commandant Sabusu to escort Wu Mone's party.
units.literal: General Baha of Ningguta ordered seventeen grain boats sent to Eheneo to go ahead, and also ordered Assistant Commandant Sabusu to escort Wu Mone and the others on their journey.

units.zh: 六月丁未，武默訥等攜三月糧，陸行經溫德亨河、庫埒訥嶺、奇爾薩河、布爾堪河、納丹弗埒城、輝發江、法河、卓隆鄂河，抵訥殷江乾，米亦至。
units.en: On dingwei day in the sixth month Wu Mone's party set out with three months' rations, marching overland past the Wenduhen River, Kulene Range, Qiersa River, Bu'erkan River, Nadanjeflo, Huifa River, Fa River, and Zhuolong'e River to the Neo River headwaters, where the grain convoy also arrived.
units.literal: On the day dingwei of the sixth month Wu Mone and the others, carrying three months' provisions, traveled overland by way of the Wenduhen River, the Kulene Range, the Qiersa River, the Bu'erkan River, the Nadanjeflo City, the Huifa River, the Fa River, and the Zhuolong'e River, reaching the dry bed of the Neo River; the grain also arrived.

units.zh: 乃乘小舟，與薩布素分道行，溯訥殷江逆流上。
units.en: They then boarded small boats, parting from Sabusu, and poled up the Neo River against the current.
units.literal: They then took small boats, traveling separately from Sabusu, and went up the Neo River against the current.

units.zh: 丙寅，會於額赫訥殷。
units.en: On bingyin day they rendezvoused at Eheneo.
units.literal: On the day bingyin they met at Eheneo.

units.zh: 一望深林無路，薩布素率眾前行，伐木開道。
units.en: Deep forest stretched ahead with no trail; Sabusu led the party forward, felling trees to cut a path.
units.literal: Before them stretched deep forest with no path; Sabusu led the men forward and cut trees to open a way.

units.zh: 遣人還告：行三十里，得一山，升其巔，緣木而望，長白山乃在百餘里外，片片白光如積玉，視之甚晰。
units.en: He sent word back: after thirty li they climbed a hill; from the summit, peering along the treetops, they sighted Mount Changbai more than a hundred li off—patches of white like piled jade, startlingly clear.
units.literal: He sent men back to report: after traveling thirty li they reached a hill; climbing its summit and looking along the treetops, they saw Mount Changbai more than a hundred li away, patches of white light like piled jade, very clearly visible.

units.zh: 戊辰，武默訥前行。
units.en: On wuchen day Wu Mone pressed forward.
units.literal: On the day wuchen Wu Mone went ahead.

units.zh: 己巳，遇薩布素於林中。
units.en: On jisi day he met Sabusu in the woods.
units.literal: On the day jisi he met Sabusu in the forest.

units.zh: 壬申黎明，大霧，莫辨山所向。
units.en: At dawn on renshen day a thick fog hid the mountain entirely.
units.literal: At dawn on the day renshen there was heavy fog, and they could not tell which way the mountain lay.

units.zh: 聞鶴唳，尋聲往，遇鹿蹊，循行至山麓，見周遭密林，中間平迤圓繞，有草無木。
units.en: They heard cranes calling, followed the sound, found a deer trail, and reached the mountain foot—a ring of dense forest enclosing a level, grassy clearing without trees.
units.literal: Hearing cranes cry, they followed the sound, came upon a deer track, and followed it to the foot of the mountain; they saw dense forest all around, with a level, gently rounded open space in the middle where there was grass but no trees.

units.zh: 前臨小林，盡處有白樺木，整若栽植，及旋行林外，仍瀰漫無所見。
units.en: Ahead lay a small wood ending in white birches aligned as if planted by hand; when they circled outside the grove, fog still hid everything.
units.literal: Before them stood a small grove; at its end were white birches, as neatly arranged as if planted; when they circled outside the grove, fog still enveloped everything and nothing could be seen.

units.zh: 跪誦敕旨，拜畢，霧開，峰巒歷歷在目，登陟有路。
units.en: They knelt, recited the edict, and bowed; when they rose the fog had lifted, the peaks stood plain before them, and a path led upward.
units.literal: They knelt and recited the imperial edict; when the prostration was finished the fog lifted, the peaks stood clear before them, and a path up the slope appeared.

units.zh: 遙望之，山修而扈，既近，則堂平而宇圜，向所睹積玉光，冰雪所凝也。
units.en: From afar the mountain rose tall and sheltering; up close its summit was level and rounded—the jade-like gleam they had seen was compacted ice and snow.
units.literal: Seen from afar the mountain was tall and embracing; when they drew near, its hall was level and its vault round; the piled-jade light they had seen before was ice and snow congealed.

units.zh: 山峻約百餘裡，巔有池，環以五峰，其四峰臨水拱峙，正南一峰稍低，分列雙闕。
units.en: The mountain climbed steeply for over a hundred li; at the summit lay a lake encircled by five peaks—four flanking the water like a bow, the southernmost slightly lower, forming twin gate towers.
units.literal: The mountain rose steeply for more than a hundred li; on its summit was a lake ringed by five peaks; four peaks faced the water and arched around it, while the one due south was slightly lower, forming a pair of gate towers.

units.zh: 池廣袤約三四十里，夾山澗水噴注，自左流者為松花江，右流者為大小訥殷河，繞山皆平林。
units.en: The lake stretched thirty or forty li across; streams burst from the slopes—the left becoming the Songhua, the right the Greater and Lesser Neo Rivers—with level forest all around the mountain.
units.literal: The lake was some thirty or forty li in breadth; mountain streams gushed in on either side; that flowing from the left was the Songhua River, that from the right the Greater and Lesser Neo Rivers; level forest surrounded the mountain on all sides.

units.zh: 武默訥瞻拜而下。
units.en: Wu Mone worshipped and came down.
units.literal: Wu Mone paid homage and descended.

units.zh: 峰巔群鹿奔逸，僕其七，墜武默訥等前。
units.en: On the summit a herd of deer stampeded; seven collapsed and fell at Wu Mone's feet.
units.literal: On the summit a herd of deer fled in panic; seven fell prostrate, dropping before Wu Mone and the others.

units.zh: 時登山者正七人，方乏食，謝山靈賜。
units.en: Only seven men had reached the summit and were nearly out of food; they thanked the mountain spirit for the gift.
units.literal: Those who had climbed the mountain numbered exactly seven and were short of food; they thanked the mountain spirit for the gift.

units.zh: 卻行未里許，欻然霧合。
units.en: They had barely gone a li downhill when fog closed in again.
units.literal: They had not gone a full li on the way back when the fog suddenly closed in again.

units.zh: 癸酉，還至前望處，終不復見山光。
units.en: On guiyou day they returned to their first lookout point, but never again caught sight of the mountain.
units.literal: On the day guiyou they returned to the place from which they had first sighted the mountain, but never again saw its light.

units.zh: 七月庚辰，至恰庫河，馬疲甚。
units.en: On gengchen day in the seventh month they reached the Qiaku River, their horses spent.
units.literal: On the day gengchen of the seventh month they reached the Qiaku River; the horses were utterly exhausted.

units.zh: 甲申，自恰庫河乘舟還，經色克騰、圖伯赫、噶爾漢、噶達渾、薩穆、薩克錫、法克什、多琿諸河，至松花江。
units.en: On jiashen day they boarded boats at the Qiaku River and sailed back past the Seketeng, Tubohe, Ga'erhan, Gadahun, Samu, Sakexi, Fakeshi, and Duohun rivers to the Songhua.
units.literal: On the day jiashen they took boats from the Qiaku River on the return journey, passing the Seketeng, Tubohe, Ga'erhan, Gadahun, Samu, Sakexi, Fakeshi, and Duohun rivers, and reached the Songhua.

units.zh: 八月丁未，還吉林，巡視寧古塔諸處。
units.en: On dingwei day in the eighth month they returned to Jilin and inspected Ningguta and the surrounding districts.
units.literal: On the day dingwei of the eighth month they returned to Jilin and inspected the region of Ningguta and elsewhere.

units.zh: 乙丑，還京師。
units.en: On yichou day they returned to the capital.
units.literal: On the day yichou they returned to the capital.

units.zh: 疏聞，詔封長白山之神，秩祀如五嶽。
units.en: Their report reached the throne, and an edict ennobled the spirit of Mount Changbai with sacrifices ranked equal to the Five Sacred Peaks.
units.literal: When their memorial reached the throne, an edict enfeoffed the spirit of Mount Changbai, with sacrificial rank equal to the Five Sacred Peaks.

units.zh: 十七年，命武默訥齎敕往封，歲時望祭如典禮。
units.en: In Kangxi 17 Wu Mone was sent with an edict to perform the enfeoffment; he conducted the seasonal observances according to established ritual.
units.literal: In the seventeenth year Wu Mone was ordered to carry an edict and go to perform the enfeoffment; seasonal worship on the first day of the month was conducted according to ritual.

units.zh: 十九年，召入養心殿，命工繪其像以賜。
units.en: In Kangxi 19 he was summoned to the Hall of Mental Cultivation, where the emperor had artists paint his portrait and bestow it upon him.
units.literal: In the nineteenth year he was summoned to the Hall of Mental Cultivation and ordered that artisans paint his portrait and present it to him as a gift.

units.zh: 諭曰：「以此像俾爾子孫世世供享，以昭恩寵。」
units.en: The emperor said: "Let your descendants worship before this portrait for all generations, as a sign of my favor."
units.literal: The instruction ran: "With this portrait let your descendants offer sacrifice generation after generation, to display imperial favor."

units.zh: 二十九年，卒，賜祭葬。
units.en: In Kangxi 29 he died, and the court granted funeral sacrifices.
units.literal: In the twenty-ninth year he died, and funeral sacrifices were granted.

units.zh: 舒蘭，納喇氏，滿洲正紅旗人。
units.en: Shu Lan, of the Nara clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Red Banner.
units.literal: Shu Lan was of the Nara clan and a Manchu of the Plain Red Banner.

units.zh: 父敦多哩，官刑部侍郎，兼佐領。
units.en: His father Dundoli was vice minister of the Board of Punishments and also commanded a banner company.
units.literal: His father Dundoli served as vice minister of the Board of Punishments and also held a company command.

units.zh: 坐鞫總督蔡毓榮罪，附和尚書希福從輕比，奪官，戍黑龍江。
units.en: While trying Governor-General Cai Yurong, he sided with Minister Xifu in leniency; he was dismissed and exiled to Heilongjiang.
units.literal: For trying the case of Governor-General Cai Yurong's crime, he sided with Minister Xifu in applying a lighter sentence; his office was stripped and he was banished to Heilongjiang.

units.zh: 舒蘭自理籓院筆帖式遷主事。
units.en: Shu Lan advanced from a clerk in the Court of Colonial Affairs to director.
units.literal: Shu Lan rose from clerk in the Court of Colonial Affairs to director.

units.zh: 康熙三十八年，從侍郎滿丕、都統烏達禪等，招降巴爾瑚三千餘人，安置察哈爾游牧地，編隸佐領。
units.en: In Kangxi 38, with Vice Minister Manpi and Commander-in-Chief Udazan, he induced over three thousand Barhu to surrender, settled them on Chahar grazing lands, and enrolled them under banner companies.
units.literal: In the thirty-eighth year of Kangxi, following Vice Minister Manpi, Commander-in-Chief Udazan, and others, he induced more than three thousand Barhu to submit, settled them on Chahar pasturelands, and registered them under banner companies.

units.zh: 未幾，巴爾瑚佐領額克圖叛，戕察哈爾副總管阿必達、驍騎校班第，掠馬駝以遁。
units.en: Soon the Barhu company commander Eketu rebelled, killed Chahar Deputy Commander Abida and Cavalry Captain Bandi, seized livestock, and fled.
units.literal: Before long the Barhu company commander Eketu rebelled, killed Chahar Deputy Commander Abida and Cavalry Captain Bandi, seized horses and camels, and fled.

units.zh: 上命喀爾喀公錫卜推哈坦等率蒙古兵追剿，舒蘭持檄傳示蒙古諸貝勒台吉，並徵察哈爾、厄魯特兵，從烏達禪會剿，擒其渠。
units.en: The emperor ordered Khalkha Prince Sibutuihatan to pursue with Mongol troops; Shu Lan carried orders to the Mongol princes and taiji and raised Chahar and Oirat forces; joining Udazan, they captured the rebel leader.
units.literal: The emperor ordered Khalkha Prince Sibutuihatan and others to lead Mongol troops in pursuit; Shu Lan carried dispatches to inform the Mongol princes and taiji, and also mobilized Chahar and Oirat troops; joining Udazan in the punitive campaign, they captured the ringleader.

units.zh: 遷內閣侍讀。
units.en: He was promoted to reader in the Grand Secretariat.
units.literal: He was transferred to reader in the Grand Secretariat.

units.zh: 四十年，命偕侍衛拉錫往探河源，諭曰：「河源雖名古爾班索里瑪勒，其發源處人跡罕到。
units.en: In Kangxi 40 he was sent with bodyguard La Xi to find the Yellow River's source. The emperor said: "Though the source is called Gurban Suurimale, its true spring lies where almost no one has gone.
units.literal: In the fortieth year he was ordered, together with the bodyguard La Xi, to explore the source of the Yellow River. The instruction ran: "Although the river's source is called Gurban Suurimale, its actual spring lies where few human feet have ever trod.

units.zh: 爾等務窮其源，察視河流自何處入雪山邊內。
units.en: You must trace it to the end and determine where the river enters Chinese territory from beyond the snow mountains.
units.literal: You must trace it to its utmost source and observe where the river enters the interior from beyond the snow mountains.

units.zh: 凡經流諸處，宜詳閱之。」
units.en: Survey every stretch of its course in detail."
units.literal: Every place it flows through should be examined in detail."

units.zh: 四月辛酉，舒蘭等發京師。
units.en: On xinyou day in the fourth month Shu Lan's party left the capital.
units.literal: On the day xinyou of the fourth month Shu Lan and the others set out from the capital.

units.zh: 五月己亥，至青海。
units.en: On jihai day in the fifth month they reached Qinghai.
units.literal: On the day jihai of the fifth month they reached Qinghai.

units.zh: 庚子，至庫庫布拉克。
units.en: On gengzi day they reached Kukubulak.
units.literal: On the day gengzi they reached Kukubulak.

units.zh: 貝勒色卜騰扎勒與偕行。
units.en: Prince Sebutengzhale accompanied them.
units.literal: Prince Sebutengzhale traveled with them.

units.zh: 六月癸亥，至鄂棱諾爾。
units.en: On guihai day in the sixth month they reached Eling Nur.
units.literal: On the day guihai of the sixth month they reached Eling Nur.

units.zh: 甲子，西行至扎棱諾爾。
units.en: On jiazi day they went west to Zhaling Nur.
units.literal: On the day jiazi they traveled west to Zhaling Nur.

units.zh: 鄂棱週二百餘裡，扎棱週三百餘裡，二諾爾距三十里許。
units.en: Eling measured over two hundred li around, Zhaling over three hundred; the two lakes lay about thirty li apart.
units.literal: Eling measured more than two hundred li in circumference, Zhaling more than three hundred; the two lakes were about thirty li apart.

units.zh: 乙丑，至星宿海，蒙古名「鄂敦塔拉」。
units.en: On yichou day they reached the Sea of Starry Constellations, known in Mongol as "Edun Tala."
units.literal: On the day yichou they reached the Sea of Starry Constellations, called in Mongol "Edun Tala."

units.zh: 星宿海之源，小泉萬億，歷歷如星，眾山環之。
units.en: At its source countless small springs glittered like stars, encircled by mountains.
units.literal: At the source of the Sea of Starry Constellations were myriads of small springs, each distinct like a star, ringed by many mountains.

units.zh: 南有山曰古爾班圖勒哈，西南有山曰布瑚珠勒赫，西有山曰巴爾布哈，北有山曰阿克塔齊勒，東北有山曰烏闌都什，蒙古總名曰「庫爾坤」，即崑崙也。
units.en: South stood Gurban Tuleha; southwest, Buhuzhulehe; west, Barbuha; north, Aktaqile; northeast, Wulandushi—the Mongols called the range collectively "Kurkun," the Kunlun.
units.literal: To the south was a mountain called Gurban Tuleha; to the southwest, Buhuzhulehe; to the west, Barbuha; to the north, Aktaqile; to the northeast, Wulandushi—the Mongol collective name for them was "Kurkun," that is, Kunlun.

units.zh: 山泉出自古爾班圖勒哈者，為噶爾瑪瑭；
units.en: The spring from Gurban Tuleha was the Garmatang;
units.literal: The spring from Gurban Tuleha was called Garmatang;

units.zh: 出自巴爾布哈者，為噶爾瑪楚木朗；
units.en: from Barbuha, the Garmachumulang;
units.literal: that from Barbuha was Garmachumulang;

units.zh: 出自阿克塔齊勒者，為噶爾瑪沁尼。
units.en: from Aktaqile, the Garmaqinni.
units.literal: that from Aktaqile was Garmaqinni.

units.zh: 三山之泉，溢為三支河，即古爾班索里瑪勒也。
units.en: Springs from the three mountains fed three branch streams—Gurban Suurimale itself.
units.literal: The springs of the three mountains overflowed into three branch rivers—this was Gurban Suurimale.

units.zh: 三河東流入扎棱諾爾，扎棱一支入鄂棱諾爾，黃河自鄂棱出。
units.en: The three rivers ran east into Zhaling Nur; a branch of Zhaling fed Eling Nur, and the Yellow River flowed out from Eling.
units.literal: The three rivers flowed east into Zhaling Nur; one branch of Zhaling entered Eling Nur, and the Yellow River issued from Eling.

units.zh: 其他山泉與平地水泉，淵淪縈繞，不可勝數，悉歸黃河東下。
units.en: Countless other mountain and plain springs pooled and converged, all feeding the Yellow River eastward.
units.literal: Other mountain springs and level-ground springs wound in deep pools beyond counting; all joined the Yellow River flowing east.

units.zh: 丁卯，舒蘭等自星宿海還，舍故道，循河流東南行。
units.en: On dingmao day Shu Lan's party left the Sea of Starry Constellations, forsook the outbound route, and followed the river southeast.
units.literal: On the day dingmao Shu Lan and the others left the Sea of Starry Constellations, abandoned the old route, and followed the river southeast.

units.zh: 己巳，登哈爾吉山，見黃河折而東，至庫庫陀羅海山，又南繞薩楚克山，复北流，經巴爾陀羅海山之南。
units.en: On jisi day they climbed Mount Ha'erji and traced the Yellow River bending east to Kukutuoluohai, looping south around Sachuke, turning north again, and passing south of Ba'ertuoluohai.
units.literal: On the day jisi they climbed Mount Ha'erji and saw the Yellow River bend east; it reached Mount Kukutuoluohai, then curved south around Mount Sachuke, turned north again, and passed south of Mount Ba'ertuoluohai.

units.zh: 庚午，達阿木尼瑪勒佔穆遜山，山最高，雲霧蔽之，不可端倪。
units.en: On gengwu day they reached Mount Amunimalezhamuxun—the loftiest peak, wrapped in cloud so its full extent could not be seen.
units.literal: On the day gengwu they reached Mount Amunimalezhamuxun; it was the highest of all, shrouded in cloud and mist so that its form could not be discerned.

units.zh: 蒙古人言長三百餘裡，有九高峰，積冰終古不消。
units.en: Mongols said it ran over three hundred li, with nine peaks whose ice never melted.
units.literal: Mongols said it stretched more than three hundred li, with nine lofty peaks whose accumulated ice never melted through the ages.

units.zh: 常雨雪，一月得晴僅三四日。
units.en: Snow and rain were nearly constant—only three or four clear days in a month.
units.literal: Snow and rain were constant; in a month there were only three or four clear days.

units.zh: 舒蘭等自此返。
units.en: Shu Lan's party turned back from here.
units.literal: Shu Lan and the others returned from this point.

units.zh: 壬申，至錫喇庫特勒，又南過僧庫爾高嶺，更百餘裡，至黃河岸。
units.en: On renshen day they reached Xilakutile, crossed Mount Sengku'ergao to the south, and after another hundred-odd li reached the Yellow River bank.
units.literal: On the day renshen they reached Xilakutile, then passed south over Mount Sengku'ergao, and after another hundred-odd li reached the bank of the Yellow River.

units.zh: 見黃河自巴爾陀羅海山東北流，經歸德堡北、達喀山南兩山峽中，流入蘭州。
units.en: They saw the Yellow River flow northeast from Ba'ertuoluohai, thread the gorge between Guide Fort and Mount Daka, and enter Lanzhou.
units.literal: They saw the Yellow River flow northeast from Mount Ba'ertuoluohai, pass between the two mountain gorges north of Guide Fort and south of Mount Daka, and enter Lanzhou.

units.zh: 自京師至星宿海，七千六百餘裡。
units.en: From the capital to the Sea of Starry Constellations was over seven thousand six hundred li.
units.literal: From the capital to the Sea of Starry Constellations was more than seven thousand six hundred li.

units.zh: 寧夏西自松山至星宿海，天氣漸低，地勢漸高，人氣閉塞，行多喘息。
units.en: West of Ningxia, from Songshan to the Sea of Starry Constellations, the air thinned, the land rose, and travelers were often short of breath.
units.literal: West of Ningxia, from Songshan to the Sea of Starry Constellations, the air grew thinner, the terrain higher, and travelers often gasped for breath.

units.zh: 九月，還京師，具疏述所經，並繪圖以進。
units.en: In the ninth month they returned to the capital, memorialized their route in detail, and presented maps.
units.literal: In the ninth month they returned to the capital, submitted a detailed memorial on their route, and presented maps.

units.zh: 上諭廷臣曰：「朕於古今山川名號，雖在邊徼遐荒，必詳考圖籍，廣詢方言，務得其正。
units.en: The emperor told his ministers: "For place-names ancient and modern, even in the farthest borderlands I examine maps, consult local usage, and insist on accuracy.
units.literal: The emperor instructed the court ministers: "In matters of ancient and modern place-names for mountains and rivers, even in remote borderlands I must examine maps and records in detail, inquire widely into local speech, and secure the correct names.

units.zh: 故遣使至崑崙，目擊詳求，載入輿圖。
units.en: That is why I sent envoys to Kunlun to verify on the ground and record the results in the imperial atlas.
units.literal: Therefore I sent envoys to Kunlun to investigate on the spot and enter the findings in the imperial atlas.

units.zh: 即如黃河源出西塞外庫爾坤山之東，眾泉渙散，燦如列星，蒙古謂之'鄂敦塔拉'，西番謂之'索里瑪勒'，中華謂之'星宿海'，是為河源。
units.en: The Yellow River rises east of Kurkun beyond the western passes; countless springs glitter like stars. Mongols call it Edun Tala, Tibetans Suurimale, Chinese the Sea of Starry Constellations—that is the source.
units.literal: Take the Yellow River: its source lies east of Kurkun Mountain beyond the western frontier; myriad springs scatter and glitter like stars in array. Mongols call it 'Edun Tala,' Tibetans 'Suurimale,' and Chinese 'the Sea of Starry Constellations'—this is the river's source.

units.zh: 彙為扎棱、鄂棱二澤。
units.en: They gather in the two lakes, Zhaling and Eling.
units.literal: They gather into the two lakes Zhaling and Eling.

units.zh: 東南行，折北，復東行，由歸德堡、積石關入蘭州，其原委可得而縷晰也。」
units.en: It runs southeast, bends north, then east again through Guide Fort and Jishi Pass into Lanzhou—its full course can now be traced in detail."
units.literal: Flowing southeast, then bending north, then east again, it passes Guide Fort and Jishi Pass to enter Lanzhou; its full course can now be traced thread by thread."

units.zh: 舒蘭累擢內閣學士。
units.en: Shu Lan rose to grand secretary of the Grand Secretariat.
units.literal: Shu Lan was promoted in succession to grand secretary of the Grand Secretariat.

units.zh: 四十五年，命往西藏封拉藏為翊法恭順汗。
units.en: In Kangxi 45 he was sent to Tibet to enfeoff Lozang as Yifa Gongshun Khan.
units.literal: In the forty-fifth year he was ordered to go to Tibet and enfeoff Lozang as the Yifa Gongshun Khan.

units.zh: 回京得風疾，遣太醫診視。
units.en: Back in the capital he fell ill with a wind disorder; court physicians were sent to treat him.
units.literal: On returning to the capital he contracted a wind ailment; imperial physicians were sent to treat him.

units.zh: 越二年，疾復發，乞休，許解任調治。
units.en: Two years later the illness returned; he asked to retire and was allowed to leave office to recover.
units.literal: Two years later the illness recurred; he requested retirement and was permitted to leave office to recuperate.

units.zh: 五十二年，疾愈，起故官。
units.en: In Kangxi 52, recovered, he was restored to his former post.
units.literal: In the fifty-second year, when he had recovered, he was restored to his former office.

units.zh: 是年以萬壽恩典，復其父敦多哩故秩。
units.en: That year, as part of the Longevity amnesty, his father Dundoli's former rank was restored.
units.literal: That year, by grace of the Longevity celebration, his father Dundoli's former rank was restored.

units.zh: 尋遷工部侍郎。
units.en: He was soon made vice minister of the Board of Works.
units.literal: Soon afterward he was transferred to vice minister of the Board of Works.

units.zh: 未幾，坐事，降三秩調用。
units.en: Soon he was implicated in a case, demoted three ranks, and reassigned.
units.literal: Before long, for an offense, he was demoted three ranks and reassigned.

units.zh: 五十九年，卒。
units.en: In Kangxi 59 he died.
units.literal: In the fifty-ninth year he died.

units.zh: 拉錫，圖伯特氏，蒙古正白旗人。
units.en: La Xi, of the Tubote clan, was a Mongol of the Plain White Banner.
units.literal: La Xi was of the Tubote clan and a Mongol of the Plain White Banner.

units.zh: 自親軍校三遷二等侍衛，偕舒蘭窮河源，進一等。
units.en: He rose from personal guard corporal through three promotions to second-class bodyguard; with Shu Lan he traced the Yellow River to its source and was promoted to first class.
units.literal: From personal guard corporal he was promoted three times to second-class bodyguard; joining Shu Lan in tracing the river source to its end, he was advanced to first class.

units.zh: 雍正初，累擢本旗都統。
units.en: Early in Yongzheng he rose to commander-in-chief of his banner.
units.literal: Early in the Yongzheng reign he was promoted in succession to commander-in-chief of his banner.

units.zh: 以治事明敏，予拜他喇布勒哈番世職，授議政大臣。
units.en: For capable administration he received the hereditary rank of Baitalabule Khan and a seat among the deliberative ministers.
units.literal: For clear and keen administration he was granted the hereditary rank of Baitalabule Khan and appointed a deliberative minister.

units.zh: 拉錫諳習旗務，奏事輒稱旨，累被褒嘉，加授拖沙喇哈番。
units.en: La Xi knew banner affairs inside out; his reports always pleased the throne; he was repeatedly praised and additionally granted the rank of Tusahara Khan.
units.literal: La Xi was thoroughly versed in banner affairs; his memorials always met with approval; he was repeatedly commended and additionally granted the rank of Tusahara Khan.

units.zh: 四年，以隱匿烏梁海事，盡削官職，降授一等侍衛，管太僕寺卿。
units.en: In Yongzheng 4, for concealing Ulianghai affairs, he lost all rank, was demoted to first-class bodyguard, and put in charge of the Court of the Imperial Stud.
units.literal: In the fourth year, for concealing matters concerning the Ulianghai, all his offices were stripped; he was demoted to first-class bodyguard and placed in charge of the Court of the Imperial Stud.

units.zh: 尋仍擢鑲白旗滿洲都統，迭署江寧將軍、天津滿洲水師營都統，授領侍衛內大臣。
units.en: He was soon promoted again to Manchu commander-in-chief of the Bordered White Banner, served in turn as acting Jiangning general and commander of the Tianjin Manchu naval camp, and was made senior imperial bodyguard minister.
units.literal: Soon he was again promoted to Manchu commander-in-chief of the Bordered White Banner, served in succession as acting Jiangning general and commander of the Tianjin Manchu naval camp, and was appointed senior imperial bodyguard minister.

units.zh: 卒。
units.en: He died.
units.literal: He died.

units.zh: 子旺札爾，初授侍衛，襲世職。
units.en: His son Wangzhar was first made a bodyguard and inherited the family rank.
units.literal: His son Wangzhar was first appointed bodyguard and inherited the hereditary rank.

units.zh: 使從侍郎阿克敦與噶爾丹定界。
units.en: He accompanied Vice Minister Akedun on a mission to fix the border with Galdan.
units.literal: He was sent to accompany Vice Minister Akedun in delimiting the border with Galdan.

units.zh: 如蘇州、如浙江按事。
units.en: He conducted investigations in Suzhou and Zhejiang.
units.literal: He went on inspection tours to Suzhou and Zhejiang.

units.zh: 累遷鑲白旗滿洲都統、理籓院侍郎、御前大臣。
units.en: He rose in turn to Manchu commander-in-chief of the Bordered White Banner, vice minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs, and minister in attendance before the throne.
units.literal: He was promoted in succession to Manchu commander-in-chief of the Bordered White Banner, vice minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs, and minister in attendance before the throne.

units.zh: 命赴金川察沿途驛站。
units.en: He was sent to Jinchuan to inspect relay stations along the route.
units.literal: He was ordered to go to Jinchuan and inspect the relay stations along the route.

units.zh: 金川平，擢領侍衛內大臣。
units.en: After Jinchuan was pacified he was promoted to senior imperial bodyguard minister.
units.literal: When Jinchuan was pacified he was promoted to senior imperial bodyguard minister.

units.zh: 卒，諡恪慎。
units.en: He died and was posthumously titled Ke-shen.
units.literal: He died and was given the posthumous title Ke-shen.

units.zh: 孫博靈阿，襲世職。
units.en: His grandson Boling'a inherited the family rank.
units.literal: His grandson Boling'a inherited the hereditary rank.

units.zh: 初授侍衛，累遷正藍旗蒙古副都統。
units.en: He began as a bodyguard and rose to Mongol deputy commander-in-chief of the Plain Blue Banner.
units.literal: He was first appointed bodyguard and was promoted in succession to Mongol deputy commander-in-chief of the Plain Blue Banner.

units.zh: 從征金川，攻當噶爾拉，撲碉受創，卒。
units.en: On the Jinchuan campaign he attacked Dangga'erla, was wounded storming a blockhouse, and died.
units.literal: He joined the campaign against Jinchuan, assaulted Dangga'erla, was wounded while storming a blockhouse, and died.

units.zh: 贈都統銜，進世職一等輕車都尉，圖形紫光閣。
units.en: He was posthumously given commander-in-chief rank, his hereditary office was raised to first-class commandant of light chariots, and his portrait was enshrined in the Hall of Purple Splendor.
units.literal: He was posthumously granted the rank of commander-in-chief, advanced in hereditary office to first-class commandant of light chariots, and his portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor.

units.zh: 乾隆四十七年，高宗命侍衛阿彌達詣西寧祭河神，再窮河源。
units.en: In Qianlong 47 the Gaozong Emperor sent bodyguard Amita to Xining to sacrifice to the river god and once more trace the Yellow River to its source.
units.literal: In the forty-seventh year of Qianlong, the Gaozong Emperor ordered the bodyguard Amita to go to Xining to sacrifice to the river god and again trace the river source to its end.

units.zh: 還奏：「星宿海西南有水名阿勒坦郭勒，更西有巨石高數丈，名阿勒坦噶達素齊老。
units.en: On returning he reported: "Southwest of the Sea of Starry Constellations lies a stream called Altan Gol; farther west stands a boulder several zhang high called Altan Gadasu Qilao.
units.literal: On his return he memorialized: "Southwest of the Sea of Starry Constellations is a stream called Altan Gol; farther west is a boulder several zhang high called Altan Gadasu Qilao.

units.zh: 蒙古語'阿勒坦'為黃金，'噶達素'為北極星，'郭勒'為河，'齊老'石也。
units.en: In Mongol altan means gold, gadasu the North Star, gol a river, and qilao a stone.
units.literal: In Mongol 'altan' means gold, 'gadasu' the North Star, 'gol' a river, and 'qilao' a stone.

units.zh: 崖壁黃金色，上有池，池中泉噴湧，釃為百道，皆黃金色。
units.en: The cliff shone golden; above it a pool fed springs that burst forth in a hundred golden streams.
units.literal: The cliff face was golden in color; above it was a pool from which springs gushed, dividing into a hundred channels, all golden-hued.

units.zh: 入阿勒坦郭勒，迴旋三百餘裡，入星宿海，為黃河真源。」
units.en: The Altan Gol wound over three hundred li before reaching the Sea of Starry Constellations—the Yellow River's true source."
units.literal: Entering the Altan Gol, it wound more than three hundred li before joining the Sea of Starry Constellations—this was the true source of the Yellow River."

units.zh: 高宗命四庫館諸臣輯河源紀略識其事。
units.en: The emperor ordered Siku scholars to compile the He Yuan Ji Lue to document the discovery.
units.literal: The Gaozong ordered scholars of the Siku Library to compile the He Yuan Ji Lue to record the matter.

units.zh: 阿彌達更名阿必達。
units.en: Amita was renamed Abida.
units.literal: Amita was renamed Abida.

units.zh: 大學士阿桂子，附見阿桂傳。
units.en: He was a son of Grand Secretary Agui; see Agui's biography.
units.literal: He was a son of Grand Secretary Agui; see the biography of Agui.

units.zh: 圖理琛，阿顏覺羅氏，滿洲正黃旗人。
units.en: Tulichen, of the Ayin Jueluo clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner.
units.literal: Tulichen was of the Ayin Jueluo clan and a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner.

units.zh: 以國子生考授內閣中書，遷侍讀。
units.en: As an Imperial Academy student he passed examination for Grand Secretariat secretary and was later promoted to reader.
units.literal: As a student of the Imperial Academy he passed examination and was appointed secretary in the Grand Secretariat, then promoted to reader.

units.zh: 坐事，奪職。
units.en: He was dismissed for an offense.
units.literal: For an offense his office was stripped.

units.zh: 康熙五十一年，特命復職，出使土爾扈特。
units.en: In Kangxi 51 he was specially restored and sent as envoy to the Torghuts.
units.literal: In the fifty-first year of Kangxi he was specially ordered restored to office and sent as envoy to the Torghuts.

units.zh: 初，土爾扈特汗阿玉奇從子阿喇布珠爾，假道準噶爾赴西藏謁達賴喇嘛。
units.en: Earlier, Torghut Khan Ayuki's nephew Alabuzhur had traveled through Dzungaria to Tibet to see the Dalai Lama.
units.literal: Earlier, Ayuki Khan of the Torghuts had a nephew, Alabuzhur, who traveled through Dzungaria to Tibet to pay homage to the Dalai Lama.

units.zh: 準噶爾台吉策妄阿喇布坦與阿玉奇構怨，阿喇布珠爾不得歸，款關乞內屬，詔封貝子，賜牧嘉峪關外黨色爾騰。
units.en: Dzungar taiji Tsewang Arabtan feuded with Ayuki; unable to return, Alabuzhur sought entry at the border, was enfeoffed as beizi, and was given pasture outside Jiayu Pass at Dangse'erteng.
units.literal: The Dzungar taiji Tsewang Arabtan bore a grudge against Ayuki; Alabuzhur could not return, came to the border seeking subject status, was enfeoffed as a beizi, and granted pasture outside Jiayu Pass at Dangse'erteng.

units.zh: 嗣阿玉奇遣使入貢，上欲歸阿喇布珠爾。
units.en: When Ayuki later sent tribute envoys, the emperor wished to send Alabuzhur home.
units.literal: Later Ayuki sent tribute envoys; the emperor wished to return Alabuzhur.

units.zh: 命圖理琛偕侍讀學士殷扎納、郎中納顏齎敕諭阿玉奇，假道鄂羅斯。
units.en: Tulichen was sent with Hanlin reader Yin Zhana and Director Nayin, bearing an edict to Ayuki by way of Russia.
units.literal: Tulichen was ordered, together with Reader of the Hanlin Academy Yin Zhana and Director Nayin, to carry an edict instructing Ayuki, traveling by way of Russia.

units.zh: 五月，圖理琛等自京師啟行，七月，至鄂羅斯境楚庫柏興。
units.en: In the fifth month Tulichen's party left the capital; in the seventh month they reached Chukuboishing in Russia.
units.literal: In the fifth month Tulichen and the others set out from the capital; in the seventh month they reached Chukuboishing in Russian territory.

units.zh: 以假道故，待其國察罕汗進止。
units.en: As they were transiting Russian territory, they waited for the Tsar's permission to proceed.
units.literal: Because they were passing through, they awaited permission from that country's Tsar.

units.zh: 五十二年正月，許假道，乃行。
units.en: In the first month of Kangxi 52 passage was granted and they continued.
units.literal: In the first month of the fifty-second year passage was granted and they set out.

units.zh: 還烏的柏興，越柏海爾湖而北，抵厄爾庫。
units.en: They returned to Udoboishing, crossed Lake Baikal northward, and reached Erku.
units.literal: They returned to Udoboishing, crossed Lake Baikal northward, and reached Erku.

units.zh: 鄂羅斯託波爾噶噶林遣其屬博爾科尼來迎。
units.en: The Tobolsk governor sent his aide Bolkoni to meet them.
units.literal: The Russian Tobolsk governor sent his subordinate Bolkoni to welcome them.

units.zh: 噶噶林者，彼國所稱總管也。
units.en: Gagalin was their title for a regional governor.
units.literal: Gagalin was their term for a regional governor.

units.zh: 圖理琛等欲行，博爾科尼言噶噶林令天使當自水路行，而昂噶拉河冰未泮，請稍駐俟之。
units.en: When they wished to move on, Bolkoni said the governor required travel by water, but the Angara was still frozen—they must wait.
units.literal: When Tulichen and the others wished to proceed, Bolkoni said the governor ordered the envoys to travel by water, but the Angara River ice had not yet broken; they were asked to wait a while.

units.zh: 三月，自昂噶拉河乘舟抵伊聶謝柏興，登陸。
units.en: In the third month they boated down the Angara to Yeniseiboishing and went ashore.
units.literal: In the third month they took boats on the Angara to Yeniseiboishing and went ashore.

units.zh: 五月，抵麻科斯科，复乘舟自揭的河順流行，經那裡穆柏興、蘇爾呼特柏興、薩瑪爾斯科、狄穆演斯科諸地。
units.en: In the fifth month they reached Makosike, then boated down the Ket past Nalimuboishing, Suerhutuboishing, Samarsike, and Dimuyansike.
units.literal: In the fifth month they reached Makosike; again they took boats down the Ket River, passing Nalimuboishing, Suerhutuboishing, Samarsike, and Dimuyansike.

units.zh: 七月，至託波爾。
units.en: In the seventh month they reached Tobol.
units.literal: In the seventh month they reached Tobol.

units.zh: 其地噶噶林名馬提飛費多里魚赤，迎至廨，留八日。
units.en: The local governor Matifeifeiduoliyuchi received them at his office and kept them eight days.
units.literal: The local governor, Matifeifeiduoliyuchi, received them at his yamen and detained them eight days.

units.zh: 仍遣博爾科尼護之行，抵鴉班沁登陸。
units.en: Bolkoni escorted them again; they landed at Yabanqin.
units.literal: Bolkoni was again sent to escort them; they went ashore at Yabanqin.

units.zh: 自費耶爾和土爾斯科越佛落克嶺，抵索里喀穆斯科，以路濘，守凍十日。
units.en: From Feiye'erhetu'ersike they crossed Foluoke Ridge to Solikamusike; the roads were impassable mud and they waited ten frozen days.
units.literal: From Feiye'erhetu'ersike they crossed Foluoke Ridge to Solikamusike; the roads were mire and they waited out ten days of freeze.

units.zh: 復行，經改郭羅多、黑林諾付、喀山、西穆必爾斯科諸地。
units.en: They continued through Gaigeluoduo, Heilinnuofu, Kazan, and Ximubiersike.
units.literal: They traveled on, passing Gaigeluoduo, Heilinnuofu, Kazan, and Ximubiersike.

units.zh: 十一月，至薩拉託付，是為鄂羅斯與土爾扈特界。
units.en: In the eleventh month they reached Saratov, the border between Russia and the Torghuts.
units.literal: In the eleventh month they reached Saratov—the border between Russia and the Torghuts.

units.zh: 水自東北來，折而南，鄂羅斯號為佛爾格，土爾扈特號為額濟勒。
units.en: The river came from the northeast and turned south—Russians called it the Volga, the Torghuts the Ejin Gol.
units.literal: The water came from the northeast and bent south; Russians called it the Volga, the Torghuts the Ejin Gol.

units.zh: 阿玉奇汗駐牧地曰瑪努託海，距此十日程，以雪盛不能行。
units.en: Ayuki Khan pastured at Manuotohai, ten days off, but deep snow blocked the way.
units.literal: Ayuki Khan's pasture was called Manuotohai, ten days' journey away; heavy snow prevented travel.

units.zh: 五十三年四月，阿玉奇遣台吉祥偉徵等來迎。
units.en: In the fourth month of Kangxi 53 Ayuki sent taiji Weizheng and others to meet them.
units.literal: In the fourth month of the fifty-third year Ayuki sent the taiji Weizheng and others to welcome them.

units.zh: 五月，圖理琛等渡額濟勒河，阿喇布珠爾之父納扎爾瑪穆特遣獻馬，卻之。
units.en: In the fifth month they crossed the Ejin Gol; Alabuzhur's father Nazarmamut sent horses as gifts, which they refused.
units.literal: In the fifth month Tulichen and the others crossed the Ejin Gol; Nazarmamut, father of Alabuzhur, sent horses as gifts, which they declined.

units.zh: 六年朔，至瑪努託海，阿玉奇擇日聽宣敕。
units.en: On the first day of the sixth month they reached Manuotohai; Ayuki chose a day to receive the edict.
units.literal: On the first day of the sixth month they reached Manuotohai; Ayuki chose a day to hear the edict proclaimed.

units.zh: 圖理琛等以上意諭之曰：「阿喇布珠爾已賜爵優養，欲遣歸爾牧地，以策妄阿喇布坦方與爾交惡，恐為所戕。
units.en: Tulichen conveyed the emperor's message: "Alabuzhur has been ennobled and well provided for; we wish to send him home to your pastures, but Tsewang Arabtan is your enemy and may kill him.
units.literal: Tulichen and the others conveyed the imperial intent: "Alabuzhur has been granted rank and generous support; we wish to send him back to your pastures, but as Tsewang Arabtan is presently at enmity with you, we fear he may be killed.

units.zh: 爾若欲令阿喇布珠爾歸，當自鄂羅斯來迎。」
units.en: If you want him back, you must come through Russia to fetch him."
units.literal: If you wish Alabuzhur to return, you must come to meet him through Russia yourself."

units.zh: 阿玉奇曰：「我雖外夷，然冠服與中國同。
units.en: Ayuki replied: "Though we are outsiders, our dress matches China's.
units.literal: Ayuki said: "Though I am an outer barbarian, my dress and cap are the same as China's.

units.zh: 鄂羅斯乃嗜慾不同、言語不通之國也，天使歸道當察其情狀。
units.en: Russia is a land of alien customs and speech; on your return, observe it closely.
units.literal: Russia is a land of different appetites and unintelligible speech; on your return, envoys, you should observe its condition.

units.zh: 鄂羅斯若以往來數故不假道，則我無由入貢矣。
units.en: If Russia refuses passage because of our frequent travel, I cannot send tribute.
units.literal: If Russia, citing frequent passage, refuses transit, I shall have no way to send tribute.

units.zh: 阿喇布珠爾荷厚恩，與歸土爾扈特同，復何疑慮？」
units.en: Alabuzhur owes deep gratitude; his return is assured—what doubt remains?"
units.literal: Alabuzhur has received great favor; his return to the Torghuts is the same—what further doubt is there?"

units.zh: 阿玉奇及納扎爾瑪穆特等各贈馬及方物，圖理琛等以越境無私交，卻不受。
units.en: Ayuki, Nazarmamut, and others offered horses and gifts; Tulichen declined, holding that envoys abroad must accept no private gifts.
units.literal: Ayuki and Nazarmamut and others each presented horses and local products; Tulichen and the others, holding that envoys abroad should have no private dealings, declined them.

units.zh: 阿玉奇待之有隆禮，留十四日，筵宴不絕。
units.en: Ayuki entertained them lavishly for fourteen days of unbroken feasting.
units.literal: Ayuki received them with grand ceremony; they stayed fourteen days with feasting unceasing.

units.zh: 复附表奏謝。
units.en: He also sent a memorial of thanks.
units.literal: He also submitted a memorial of thanks.

units.zh: 圖理琛等遂行，由舊路歸，鄂羅斯遣護如初。
units.en: Tulichen's party set out homeward by the same route, with Russian escorts as before.
units.literal: Tulichen and the others then departed, returning by the same route; Russia sent escorts as before.

units.zh: 五十四年三月，還京師。
units.en: In the third month of Kangxi 54 they returned to the capital.
units.literal: In the third month of the fifty-fourth year they returned to the capital.

units.zh: 是役也，往返三載餘，經行數万裡。
units.en: The mission lasted over three years round trip and crossed tens of thousands of li.
units.literal: This mission lasted more than three years round trip and covered tens of thousands of li.

units.zh: 蓋土爾扈特為鄂羅斯所隔，遠阻聲教，而鄂羅斯又故導我使紆道行。
units.en: The Torghuts were cut off by Russia, far from the court's reach, and Russia deliberately sent our envoys by roundabout routes.
units.literal: The Torghuts were cut off by Russia, far from imperial influence, and Russia deliberately led our envoys by circuitous routes.

units.zh: 圖理琛奉使無辱命，既歸國，入對，述往還事狀，並撰異域錄，首冠輿圖，次為行記，呈上覽。
units.en: Tulichen fulfilled his mission honorably; on return he had audience, recounted the journey, and compiled the Record of Strange Lands—maps first, then a travel narrative—for the emperor's review.
units.literal: Tulichen discharged his mission without disgrace; on returning he had audience, recounted the journey, and compiled the Record of Strange Lands, opening with maps and continuing with a travel narrative, which he presented for imperial review.

units.zh: 上嘉悅，尋授兵部員外郎。
units.en: The emperor was pleased and soon made him vice director in the Board of War.
units.literal: The emperor was pleased and soon appointed him vice director in the Board of War.

units.zh: 阿喇布珠爾亦遂留牧黨色爾騰不復遣，再傳至其子丹忠，雍正中，遷牧額濟內河。
units.en: Alabuzhur stayed at Dangse'erteng and was never sent home; his son Danzhong, in Yongzheng, moved the herds to the Ejin River inside the frontier.
units.literal: Alabuzhur likewise remained pasturing at Dangse'erteng and was not sent back; the line passed to his son Danzhong, who in the Yongzheng era moved pasture to the Ejin River within the frontier.

units.zh: 圖理琛遷郎中。
units.en: Tulichen was promoted to director.
units.literal: Tulichen was transferred to director.

units.zh: 世宗即位，命赴廣東察籓庫，就擢廣東布政使。
units.en: When Yongzheng acceded, he was sent to inspect Guangdong's treasury and was promoted provincial administration commissioner on the spot.
units.literal: When the Shizong Emperor acceded, Tulichen was ordered to Guangdong to inspect the treasury and was there promoted provincial administration commissioner of Guangdong.

units.zh: 調陝西。
units.en: He was transferred to Shaanxi.
units.literal: He was transferred to Shaanxi.

units.zh: 三年，擢巡撫。
units.en: In Yongzheng 3 he was made governor.
units.literal: In the third year he was promoted governor.

units.zh: 五年，召為兵部侍郎，調吏部。
units.en: In Yongzheng 5 he was recalled as vice minister of War, then moved to the Board of Civil Office.
units.literal: In the fifth year he was summoned as vice minister of the Board of War and transferred to the Board of Civil Office.

units.zh: 偕喀爾喀郡王額駙策淩等往定喀爾喀與鄂羅斯界。
units.en: With Khalkha Prince and imperial son-in-law Celeng he went to delimit the Khalkha–Russia border.
units.literal: Together with Khalkha Prince and imperial son-in-law Celeng and others he went to fix the border between Khalkha and Russia.

units.zh: 仍調兵部。
units.en: He was transferred back to the Board of War.
units.literal: He was again transferred to the Board of War.

units.zh: 六年，追議前定界時，與鄂羅斯使臣薩瓦鳴砲謝天，私立木牌，並擅納鄂羅斯貿易人入界；
units.en: In Yongzheng 6 a review of the border mission charged that with Russian envoy Sava he had fired cannon to thank Heaven, erected markers without authorization, and admitted Russian traders across the border;
units.literal: In the sixth year, on review of the earlier border delimitation, it was charged that with the Russian envoy Sava he had fired cannon to thank Heaven, erected wooden markers on his own authority, and improperly admitted Russian traders within the border;

units.zh: 又前任陝西巡撫時，將天下兵數繕摺私給將軍延信，逮問論斬。
units.en: and as Shaanxi governor he had privately given General Yanxin a memorial listing empire-wide troop strengths; he was arrested and sentenced to death.
units.literal: further, while governor of Shaanxi he had privately given General Yanxin a memorial listing troop strengths empire-wide; he was arrested, tried, and sentenced to death.

units.zh: 詔宥免，遣築扎克拜達里克城。
units.en: An edict pardoned him and sent him to build Zakbaydarik.
units.literal: An edict pardoned him and sent him to build Zakbaydarik City.

units.zh: 高宗即位，授內閣學士，遷工部侍郎。
units.en: When Qianlong acceded he was made grand secretary and vice minister of the Board of Works.
units.literal: When the Gaozong acceded he was appointed grand secretary of the Grand Secretariat and transferred to vice minister of the Board of Works.

units.zh: 乾隆元年，以老解侍郎任，仍為內閣學士。
units.en: In Qianlong 1, citing age, he left the vice ministership but remained grand secretary.
units.literal: In the first year of Qianlong, on grounds of age he was relieved of the vice ministership but remained grand secretary.

units.zh: 二年，引疾去。
units.en: In Qianlong 2 he retired on grounds of illness.
units.literal: In the second year he retired citing illness.

units.zh: 五年，卒。
units.en: In Qianlong 5 he died.
units.literal: In the fifth year he died.

units.zh: 何國宗，字翰如，順天大興人。
units.en: He Guozong, whose style was Hanru, came from Daxing in Shuntian.
units.literal: He Guozong, style name Hanru, was a native of Daxing in Shuntian.

units.zh: 康熙五十一年進士，改庶吉士，命直內廷學算法。
units.en: In Kangxi 51 he passed the jinshi, entered the Hanlin as a bachelor, and was assigned to the inner court to study calendrical science.
units.literal: In the fifty-first year of Kangxi he passed the jinshi examination, entered the Hanlin as a bachelor, and was ordered to serve in the inner court studying calendrical methods.

units.zh: 五十二年，命編輯律曆淵源。
units.en: In Kangxi 52 he was ordered to compile the Origins of Pitch and Calendar.
units.literal: In the fifty-second year he was ordered to compile the Origins of Pitch and Calendar.

units.zh: 未散館，授編修。
units.en: Before completing Hanlin training he was appointed compiler.
units.literal: Before leaving the Hanlin academy he was appointed compiler.

units.zh: 三遷至庶子。
units.en: He rose through three promotions to tutor in the Heir Apparent's household.
units.literal: He was promoted three times to tutor in the Heir Apparent's household.

units.zh: 雍正初，授侍讀學士，再遷至內閣學士。
units.en: Early in Yongzheng he became Hanlin reader and then grand secretary.
units.literal: Early in Yongzheng he was appointed reader of the Hanlin Academy and was again promoted to grand secretary.

units.zh: 三年，命視黃、運河道，奏請增築戴村石壩，疏濬東昌城南七里河、城北魏家灣及德州城南減河；
units.en: In Yongzheng 3 he was sent to inspect the Yellow River and Grand Canal; he proposed enlarging the Daicun stone dam and dredging the Qili River south of Dongchang, Weijiawan north of the city, and the flood channel south of Dezhou;
units.literal: In the third year he was ordered to inspect the Yellow River and Grand Canal waterways; he memorialized to enlarge the stone dam at Daicun and dredge the Qili River south of Dongchang, Weijiawan north of the city, and the flood-relief channel south of Dezhou;

units.zh: 又以汶、泗泉源紆遠，請專設管泉通判；
units.en: because the Wen and Si headwaters lay far upstream, he also asked for a dedicated subprefect to manage the springs;
units.literal: because the Wen and Si spring sources were far upstream, he also requested a dedicated subprefect to manage the springs;

units.zh: 又請修高家堰石堤。
units.en: and he proposed repairing the stone dike at Gaojiayan.
units.literal: and he also requested repair of the stone dike at Gaojiayan.

units.zh: 上皆允其請，並以高家堰石堤工衝要，命發帑興修。
units.en: The emperor approved all requests and, deeming the Gaojiayan dike critical, ordered treasury funds for its repair.
units.literal: The emperor approved all his requests and, because the Gaojiayan stone dike was critically important, ordered treasury funds for its construction.

units.zh: 復奏言：「運河自臨清以上，賴衛水以濟。
units.en: He memorialized again: "Above Linqing the canal depends on the Wei River.
units.literal: He memorialized again: "Above Linqing the canal depends on the Wei River for supply.

units.zh: 衛水發源百泉，益以丹、洹二水，其流始盛。
units.en: The Wei rises at the Hundred Springs, swelled by the Dan and Huan, before its flow is adequate.
units.literal: The Wei rises at the Hundred Springs, augmented by the Dan and Huan rivers, and only then becomes ample.

units.zh: 請疏百泉為三渠，洹河亦筑壩開渠引水，一分灌田，三分濟運。」
units.en: I propose dividing the Hundred Springs into three channels and on the Huan building a dam and canal—one share for irrigation, three for the transport canal."
units.literal: I request dredging the Hundred Springs into three channels; on the Huan River also build a dam and open a channel—one part for irrigation, three parts for the canal."

units.zh: 上從其議。
units.en: The emperor approved.
units.literal: The emperor adopted his proposal.

units.zh: 旋以山東巡撫塞楞額奏言國宗等奉使所經州縣，供億白金七千六百有奇。
units.en: Soon Shandong Governor Saleng'e reported that counties along Guozong's route had supplied over seven thousand six hundred taels of silver.
units.literal: Soon the Shandong governor Saleng'e memorialized that the counties Guozong's mission passed through had supplied more than seven thousand six hundred taels of silver.

units.zh: 上責國宗不惜物力，負任使，坐降調。
units.en: The emperor rebuked Guozong for wasting resources and failing his mission; he was demoted and reassigned.
units.literal: The emperor rebuked Guozong for not sparing resources and failing his commission; he was demoted and reassigned.

units.zh: 五年，授大理寺卿。
units.en: In Yongzheng 5 he was made president of the Court of Judicial Review.
units.literal: In the fifth year he was appointed president of the Court of Judicial Review.

units.zh: 六年，复擢內閣學士，遷工部侍郎。
units.en: In Yongzheng 6 he was again made grand secretary and vice minister of the Board of Works.
units.literal: In the sixth year he was again promoted to grand secretary and transferred to vice minister of the Board of Works.

units.zh: 八年，命與侍郎牛鈕督修北運河減水壩，並濬引河。
units.en: In Yongzheng 8 he and Vice Minister Niuchu were ordered to repair flood-relief dams on the Northern Canal and dredge diversion channels.
units.literal: In the eighth year he was ordered, together with Vice Minister Niuchu, to supervise repair of flood-relief dams on the Northern Canal and dredge diversion channels.

units.zh: 國宗等議捍護河西務北堤及耍兒渡魚鱗壩，別開塌河淀下流賈家沽洩水河，建築三里淺、筐兒港、張家莊諸處挑水壩，上命如議速行。
units.en: Guozong proposed protecting the Hexiwu north dike and Shua'erdu scale-pattern dam, opening a drain at Jiajiagu below Tahedian, and building diversion dams at Sanliqian, Kuang'ergang, and Zhangjiazhuang; the emperor ordered immediate action.
units.literal: Guozong and others proposed protecting the north dike at Hexiwu and the scale-pattern dam at Shua'erdu, opening a drainage channel at Jiajiagu below Tahedian, and building water-diversion dams at Sanliqian, Kuang'ergang, and Zhangjiazhuang; the emperor ordered these carried out at once.

units.zh: 九年，兼河東河道總督。
units.en: In Yongzheng 9 he also served as director-general of the Hedong waterways.
units.literal: In the ninth year he also served as director-general of the Hedong waterways.

units.zh: 田文鏡奏戴村初建玲瓏、亂石、滾水三壩。
units.en: Tian Wenjing reported that at Daicun the Linglong, Luanshi, and Gunshui dams had first been built.
units.literal: Tian Wenjing memorialized that at Daicun the Linglong, Luanshi, and Gunshui dams were first built.

units.zh: 汶水盛漲，自壩面流入鹽河歸海。
units.en: When the Wen swelled, water spilled over the dam into the salt river and on to the sea.
units.literal: When the Wen River swelled, water flowed over the dam face into the salt river and out to sea.

units.zh: 國宗等增築石壩，水不能過，瀕河連年被患。
units.en: Guozong's party enlarged the stone dam until water could not pass, and riverside counties suffered floods year after year.
units.literal: Guozong and others enlarged the stone dam; water could not pass through, and counties along the river suffered disaster year after year.

units.zh: 請毀石壩，復為亂石、滾水壩。
units.en: They asked to demolish the stone dam and restore the Luanshi and Gunshui spillways.
units.literal: They requested demolishing the stone dam and restoring the Luanshi and Gunshui dams.

units.zh: 上責國宗勘工錯誤，貽害民間，奪官。
units.en: The emperor blamed Guozong for faulty surveying that harmed the people and stripped him of office.
units.literal: The emperor rebuked Guozong for surveying errors that harmed the people and stripped his office.

units.zh: 乾隆初，起充算學館、律呂館總裁。
units.en: Early in Qianlong he was recalled as chief compiler of the Mathematical Institute and the Pitch and Calendar Institute.
units.literal: Early in Qianlong he was reinstated as chief compiler of the Mathematical Institute and the Pitch and Calendar Institute.

units.zh: 九年，賜秩視三品。
units.en: In Qianlong 9 he was granted rank equivalent to third grade.
units.literal: In the ninth year he was granted rank equivalent to third grade.

units.zh: 尋授左副都御史。
units.en: He was soon made left vice censor-in-chief.
units.literal: Soon he was appointed left vice censor-in-chief.

units.zh: 十年，兼領飲天監正。
units.en: In Qianlong 10 he also served as director of the Imperial Astronomical Bureau.
units.literal: In the tenth year he also served as director of the Imperial Astronomical Bureau.

units.zh: 十三年，遷工部侍郎。
units.en: In Qianlong 13 he was made vice minister of the Board of Works.
units.literal: In the thirteenth year he was transferred to vice minister of the Board of Works.

units.zh: 康熙間，聖祖命製皇輿全覽圖，以天度定準望，一度當二百里，遣使如奉天，循行混同、鴨綠二江，至朝鮮分界處，測繪為圖。
units.en: Under Kangxi the Sacred Ancestor ordered the Complete Map of the Imperial Dominion, fixing scale at two hundred li per degree of latitude; envoys went to Fengtian, followed the Hun/Tong and Yalu rivers to the Korean border, and surveyed the route.
units.literal: During Kangxi the Sacred Ancestor ordered production of the Complete Map of the Imperial Dominion, using celestial degrees to fix sightlines at two hundred li per degree; envoys were sent to Fengtian to follow the Hun/Tong and Yalu rivers to the Korean border and survey maps.

units.zh: 以鴨綠、圖門二江間未詳晰，五十年，命烏喇總管穆克登偕按事部員復往詳察。
units.en: Because the Yalu–Tumen stretch remained unclear, in Kangxi 50 Director Mukedeng of Wula was sent back with ministry investigators for a detailed survey.
units.literal: Because the stretch between the Yalu and Tumen was not clear, in the fiftieth year Director Mukedeng of Wula was ordered, with investigating ministry officials, to return for detailed inspection.

units.zh: 國宗弟國棟亦以通曆法直內廷。
units.en: Guozong's younger brother Guodong, skilled in calendrics, also served in the inner court.
units.literal: Guozong's younger brother Guodong also, through mastery of calendrics, served in the inner court.

units.zh: 五十三年，命國棟等周歷江以南諸行省，測北極高度及日景。
units.en: In Kangxi 53 Guodong and others were ordered to tour the provinces south of the Yangtze, measuring polar altitude and the sun's shadow.
units.literal: In the fifty-third year Guodong and others were ordered to tour the provinces south of the Yangtze, measuring polar altitude and solar shadow.

units.zh: 五十八年，圖成，為全圖一，離合凡三十二幀，別為分省圖，省各一幀。
units.en: In Kangxi 58 the map was finished: one complete atlas of thirty-two sheets, plus a separate provincial sheet for each province.
units.literal: In the fifty-eighth year the map was finished—one complete map in thirty-two assembled sheets, and separate provincial maps, one sheet per province.

units.zh: 命蔣廷錫示群臣，諭曰：「朕費三十餘年心力，始得告成。
units.en: Jiang Tingxi was told to show it to the ministers. The emperor said: "I spent more than thirty years on this before it was done.
units.literal: Jiang Tingxi was ordered to show it to the ministers. The instruction ran: "I spent more than thirty years of effort before this was achieved.

units.zh: 山脈水道，俱與禹貢合。
units.en: Mountains and waterways all match the Yu Gong.
units.literal: Mountain ranges and waterways all accord with the Yu Gong.

units.zh: 爾以此與九卿詳閱，如有不合處，九卿有知者，舉出奏明。」
units.en: Have the Nine Ministers review it carefully; if anything is wrong, let whoever knows of it report it in memorial."
units.literal: Take this and have the Nine Ministers review it in detail; if anything does not fit, let any minister who knows bring it forward in memorial."

units.zh: 乃鐫以銅版，藏內府。
units.en: It was engraved on copper plates and stored in the inner palace.
units.literal: It was then engraved on copper plates and stored in the inner palace.

units.zh: 高宗既定準噶爾，乾隆二十一年，命國宗偕侍衛努克三、哈清阿率欽天監西洋人往伊犁，自巴里坤分西北兩路，測天度繪圖。
units.en: After Qianlong pacified Dzungaria, in Qianlong 21 Guozong was sent with bodyguards Nukesan and Haqing'a to lead Astronomical Bureau Europeans to Ili; from Barkol they split into northwest and southwest routes to measure latitude and survey maps.
units.literal: After the Gaozong had pacified Dzungaria, in the twenty-first year of Qianlong Guozong was ordered, with bodyguards Nukesan and Haqing'a, to lead Westerners of the Astronomical Bureau to Ili; from Barkol they divided into northwest and southwest routes to measure celestial degrees and survey maps.

units.zh: 既還報，命署左都御史。
units.en: On their return he was ordered to serve as acting left censor-in-chief.
units.literal: On their return he was ordered to act as left censor-in-chief.

units.zh: 二十二年，授禮部尚書。
units.en: In Qianlong 22 he was made minister of Rites.
units.literal: In the twenty-second year he was appointed minister of Rites.

units.zh: 以京察舉弟國棟，​​坐徇庇，奪官。
units.en: In the metropolitan evaluation he recommended his brother Guodong; for favoritism he was stripped of office.
units.literal: In the metropolitan evaluation he recommended his brother Guodong; for favoritism his office was stripped.

units.zh: 尋授編修，直上書房。
units.en: He was soon made compiler and assigned to the Upper Study.
units.literal: Soon he was appointed compiler and served in the Upper Study.

units.zh: 二十八年，复授內閣學士。
units.en: In Qianlong 28 he was again made grand secretary.
units.literal: In the twenty-eighth year he was again appointed grand secretary.

units.zh: 是歲，上以諸回部悉定，復遣尚書明安圖等往測天度繪圖，是為乾隆內府皇輿圖。
units.en: That year, with the Muslim regions pacified, the emperor again sent Minister Ming Antu and others to measure and map—the Qianlong inner-palace imperial atlas.
units.literal: That year, with all Muslim regions pacified, the emperor again sent Minister Ming Antu and others to measure celestial degrees and survey maps—this was the Qianlong inner-palace imperial map.

units.zh: 二十六年，遷禮部侍郎。
units.en: In Qianlong 26 he was made vice minister of Rites.
units.literal: In the twenty-sixth year he was transferred to vice minister of Rites.

units.zh: 二十七年，以老休致。
units.en: In Qianlong 27 he retired on grounds of age.
units.literal: In the twenty-seventh year he retired on grounds of age.

units.zh: 三十一年，卒。
units.en: In Qianlong 31 he died.
units.literal: In the thirty-first year he died.

units.zh: 論曰：國家撫有疆宇，謂之版圖，版言乎其有民，圖言乎其有地。
units.en: The commentator writes: When the state holds territory, it is called ban tu—ban refers to having people, tu to having land.
units.literal: The commentator says: When the state extends its rule over territory, this is called ban tu—ban speaks of having people, tu of having land.

units.zh: 聖祖東訪長白山，西探河源，北撫土爾扈特，武默訥、舒蘭、圖理琛奉使稱職。
units.en: The Sacred Ancestor visited Changbai in the east, traced the river source in the west, and received the Torghuts in the north; Wu Mone, Shu Lan, and Tulichen all served ably as envoys.
units.literal: The Sacred Ancestor inspected Mount Changbai in the east, explored the river source in the west, and comforted the Torghuts in the north; Wu Mone, Shu Lan, and Tulichen discharged their missions worthily.

units.zh: 觀所還奏，曲折詳盡，歷歷如繪。
units.en: Their returned memorials are exhaustive in detail, vivid as paintings.
units.literal: Reading their returned memorials, the detail is exhaustive, vivid as painting.

units.zh: 國宗以明算事聖祖，又幸老壽，迨高宗朝，詣新疆測繪。
units.en: Guozong, expert in calculation, served the Sacred Ancestor and lived to great age; under Qianlong he went to Xinjiang to survey and map.
units.literal: Guozong, skilled in calculation, served the Sacred Ancestor and was blessed with long life; reaching the Gaozong reign he went to Xinjiang to survey.

units.zh: 康熙、乾隆兩內府圖皆躬與編摹。
units.en: He personally helped compile both the Kangxi and Qianlong inner-palace atlases.
units.literal: He personally took part in compiling both the Kangxi and Qianlong inner-palace maps.

units.zh: 揆之於古，其裴秀、賈耽之倫歟？
units.en: Judged against antiquity, is he not the equal of Pei Xiu and Jia Dan?
units.literal: Measured against antiquity, is he not in the company of Pei Xiu and Jia Dan?
